title: The 7Ps of Marketing Explained Simply | Marketing Management Ep 14
description:
One Monday, Arjun was sick and his cousin did the Laddoo Lab deliveries. He came after the school bus had gone, two packs were crushed, and he never said who he was. The laddoos were perfect, but the service failed. In this animated lesson we see why services need three more Ps, and how the extended marketing mix, the 7Ps, fixes that Monday.

You will see why services are different (you cannot touch them first, they are made as they are delivered, and they vary from day to day), and how Bernard Booms and Mary Jo Bitner added people, process and physical evidence to the 4Ps in 1981. Then we replay the same Monday twice on one clock line, the old way with no list and no checks, and the new way with a reminder, Nani's pack check, a route card, a sealed pack and a photo message, arriving ten minutes before the bus. We look at all seven Ps around one customer, see the extra Ps at work today in an airline, a hospital, a bank and a hotel, and weigh the honest trade-off: better service costs time and money, and some say the 4Ps already cover it.

This is Episode 14 of our Marketing Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
